notes.title: My Empire v1.2.0 Patch Released
notes.notes:
The v1.2.0 patch for My Empire is now available.  This update adds a new rotate camera mode, and allows cities to put their production points towards Coins or Research.  See the full release notes below, thanks for playing, and stay tuned for more!

https://www.ape-apps.com/viewpage.php?p=39846
